To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the shortest path algorithm can be used to find converging paths, and that the shortest path converging path algorithm can find converging paths with the shortest possible length.
the first algorithm can find a converging path pair in time O(n2), the second one in O(n), and the last one in time O(n) on average.
the first algorithm is a simple extension of the Dijkstra algorithm; the second and third algorithm are based on routing information in the network and are more efficient than the first.
